purpose: read-only comparison of Math-Verify answer extraction against the frozen M5 manual audit

modes.raw_default: parse(full_response) with v0.9.0 defaults, including fallback; diagnostic only
modes.default_numeric_eos: for EOS only, retain a unique finite real numeric Math-Verify parse result; strict final line wins
modes.anchor_numeric_eos: same wrapper, but for invalid final lines use LatexExtractionConfig and ExprExtractionConfig with try_extract_without_anchor=False, fallback_mode=no_fallback, extraction_mode=first_match

acceptance_for_training: zero disagreement with known manual candidates and zero extraction on manually unresolved EOS responses; report coverage and skip rates before any training integration
